claim_boundary: discarded supervised state-sufficiency probe only; not a runtime coordinator, TD/RL result, composition result, or long-horizon result
model_input_contract: only focal_encoded_state enters each network; proposal_action indexes its 28-output row; Q1 and outcome fields never enter scoring

positive_selected_ee.rule: mean > 0, seed-t95 lower > 0, and >=8/10 seeds positive

seed_joint_coverage.rule: >= 8/10 seeds contain an accepted joint-positive row
